integrity: All-parameter proof given; finite corroboration independently recomputes complete deletion-output sets and counts. Independent external audit not performed. The q=2 and one-deleted-period specializations are acknowledged as prior results.
scientific_limitations: Pairwise distinct symbols within a complete repeated period are essential. Does not cover mixed period directions, repeated-letter periods, or cyclic output equivalence. Normal asymptotics assume a fixed alphabet. Possible earlier unindexed equivalents remain a priority risk.
title: Bounded-digit law for complements of repeated permutation words
